display.purpose: displayLarge (36sp Bold) and displaySmall (32sp Bold) for splash & landing hero titles.

headline.purpose: headlineLarge (28sp SemiBold), headlineMedium (22sp SemiBold), headlineSmall (18sp SemiBold) for screen headers and participant titles.

title.purpose: titleLarge (16sp SemiBold) and titleMedium (14sp Medium) for card titles, places, and member rows.

body.purpose: bodyLarge (16sp), bodyMedium (14sp), bodySmall (12sp) with ~1.45x-1.5x line heights tuned for Vietnamese diacritics.

label.purpose: labelLarge (14sp SemiBold), labelMedium (12sp SemiBold), labelSmall (11sp Medium) for pills, tabs, and actions.

native.typography: Stitch Type.kt scale aligning Material 3 typography tokens with Be Vietnam Pro hierarchy; Be Vietnam Pro loaded via Google Fonts on web landing page and matched natively via Material 3 weights/spacing on Android.
native.shapes: AnVeShapes (8/12/16/24/28dp) plus CircleShape (9999dp) for primary pill CTAs, status pills, and navigation active indicators.
native.dynamicColor: Opt-in; disabled by default to preserve Warm Tactile Minimalism palette.

native.panelLimitations: Static HTML/CSS illustrations are not native UI previews or Android behavior specifications. Native hover, focus, pressed, keyboard and TalkBack semantics live in Compose.

narrative.overview:
AnVề uses the Stitch Warm Tactile Minimalism design system: Forest Green (#3D602F) primary actions, Moss Sage (#557945) containers and active nav pills, Soft Blush (#F1DDE4) secondary accents, Warm Paper Cream (#FDF9F2) stepped surfaces, Charcoal/Olive Ink (#1C1C18 / #43483E) typography, and Emergency Rose (#9E3E56) SOS surfaces.

The interface pairs tactile rounded geometry (24dp cards, CircleShape pill buttons) with calm Vietnamese copy so voluntary family safety and location sharing never feels intrusive or alarmist.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Tactile Minimalism palette: Forest Green, Soft Blush, and Paper Cream across light and dark modes.
Be Vietnam Pro scale with generous Vietnamese diacritic line heights and Clear Charcoal Ink contrast.
CircleShape pill buttons and tactile 16dp-24dp rounded cards with subtle hairline borders.
Consent, capture state, freshness, and emergency controls clearly separated.

rules.name: The Paired Roles Rule
rules.body: Always pair a container and content role together and verify >= 4.5:1 contrast in ThemeContrastTest.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Use MaterialTheme.typography roles from Type.kt and Android sp scaling across all Compose surfaces.

rules.name: The Tactile Card & Pill Rule
rules.body: Primary actions use CircleShape pill geometry; cards use stepped cream surfaces with 1dp outlineVariant hairlines and avoid card-inside-card nesting.

rules.name: The Native State Rule
rules.body: Preserve Material interaction semantics, loading, empty, error, offline, and TalkBack accessibility on real Compose controls.

dos: Do use semantic Material color roles and test light/dark contrast.
Do use native Compose controls, real Vietnamese strings from strings.xml, and Android dp/sp units.
Do preserve explicit unknown, loading, offline and permission states.
Do keep consent, system permissions, capture state and viewer access distinguishable.
donts: Don't interpret a stale location or missing update as evidence of a person's safety or danger.
Don't bypass ThemeContrastTest or pair primaryContainer with unverified light ink.
Don't imply a report has been shared before explicit user action.
Don't present local JVM tests or APK builds as emulator or physical-device validation.
